description: This file contains serialization utility functions for torch optimizers, including saving and loading optimizer state, parameter groups, buffers, and related data structures, primarily used for checkpointing and restoring optimizer states.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Template functions to serialize optimizer state, parameter groups, and buffers to an archive.

methods.name: deque_to_list
methods.description: Converts a std::deque to a c10::List for serialization.

methods.name: list_to_deque
methods.description: Converts a c10::List to a std::deque for deserialization.
